name: Kore
overview: Kore was a male member of the tribe of Levi, noted in Scripture as a descendant of Korah. He is identified primarily as the father of Shallum and the son of Abiasaph, situating him within a significant Levitical lineage. His role is briefly mentioned without additional personal details.
namesAndTitles: The name Kore means "proclaimer," reflecting a possible role or characteristic, though the Bible does not explicitly connect this meaning to his life. This proper name is recorded in 1 Chronicles 9:19 without indication that it was divinely given.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Kore as the father of Shallum and the son of Abiasaph. He is also noted as a descendant of Korah, linking him to a notable Levitical family line. These relationships help place him within the genealogical context of the tribe of Levi.
scriptureSignificance: Kore's significance lies in his connection to the Levitical lineage descended from Korah, a family known for its service in the tabernacle and temple. His mention in 1 Chronicles 9:19 underscores the importance of genealogical records in preserving the heritage and roles of the Levites. Through Kore, the continuity of the Korahite line is maintained, which had implications for Levitical duties and worship practices.
